units.raw_tex: In this paper, we analyze the global convergence of coordinate gradient descent algorithm for smooth but non-convex optimization problem

Let $(\Omega,\mathcal{F},\bP)$ be a probability space and let $\mathbb{T}$ be a semigroup with $\mathcal{B}(\mathbb{T})$ being its Borel $\sigma$-algebra. $\mathbb{T}$ serves as the notion of time. In the setting of Algorithm~\ref{alg:random CGD}, we have $\mathbb{T}=\bN$, corresponding to the one-sided discrete time setting. Other possible examples of $\mathbb{T}$ include $\mathbb{T}=\bZ$, $\mathbb{T}=\bR_{\geq 0}$, and $\mathbb{T}=\bR$, with the assumption that $0\in\mathbb{T}$.

\item{\emph{Probability space}.} For each $t \in \bN$, denote  $(\Omega_t,\Sigma_t,\bP_t)$ the usual probability space for the distribution $\mathcal{U}_{\{1,2,\dots,n\}}\times \mathcal{U}_{[\alpha_{\min},\alpha_{\max}]}$, where $\mathcal{U}_{\{1,2,\dots,n\}}$ and $\mathcal{U}_{[\alpha_{\min},\alpha_{\max}]}$ are the uniform distributions on the set $\{1,2,\dots,n\}$ and interval $[\alpha_{\min},\alpha_{\max}]$ respectively. 
		Let $(\Omega,\mathcal{F},\bP)$ be the product probability space of all $(\Omega_t,\Sigma_t,\bP_t),\ t\in\bN$. Denote $\pi_t$ as the projection from $(\Omega,\mathcal{F},\bP)$ onto $(\Omega_t,\Sigma_t,\bP_t), \ t \in \bN$. Thus, a sample $\omega\in\Omega$ can be represented as a sequence  $((i_0,\alpha_0),(i_1,\alpha_1),\dots)$, where $(i_t,\alpha_t)=\pi_t(\omega),\ t\in\bN$. declaration_text: For a measurable invertible matrix cocycle with integrable positive parts of log norms of its generator and inverse, the multiplicative ergodic theorem gives the positive-definite limiting root matrix, its measurable Lyapunov spectrum and filtration, vector growth rates, forward invariance of the filtration, and almost surely constant spectral data when the base is ergodic, as stated in B0016.

nodes.title: 对称矩阵谱扰动
declaration_text: If real symmetric matrices converge in operator norm, their ordered eigenvalues converge; spectral projections onto a cluster separated by a spectral gap converge in operator norm. Applied to the limiting root matrices, this controls logarithmic singular-value growth rates and the positive-exponent spectral subspace.

nodes.title: 标准概率极限定理
declaration_text: Integrable independent identically distributed variables obey the strong and weak laws of large numbers. Almost sure convergence on a finite measure space is uniform outside a set of arbitrarily small measure by Egorov's theorem. Probability is continuous under increasing unions. Independent tail events have probability zero or one; hence the independent product shift is ergodic.

nodes.title: 光滑函数的局部估计
declaration_text: For a C² function, the gradient admits its first-order Taylor expansion and an integral Hessian representation. A uniformly bounded Hessian makes the gradient Lipschitz. At a critical point with invertible Hessian, the gradient norm is locally bounded below by a positive constant times the distance to that point.

nodes.title: 离散集合与零测可数并
declaration_text: A subset of Euclidean space whose every point is isolated is countable, by second countability. A countable union of measurable events of probability zero has probability zero.

nodes.title: 条件伯努利计数比较
declaration_text: For adapted zero-one trials with conditional success probability at least p, the probability of at most k successes in t trials is bounded above by the corresponding Binomial(t,p) lower tail. If the bound is imposed only before a stopping time, the probability of surviving through t with at most k successes obeys the same upper bound.

declaration_text: The Sherman-Morrison formula gives the inverse of an invertible rank-one perturbation of the identity. Singular values bound matrix action on the corresponding singular subspaces, and images of orthogonal right singular components are orthogonal. For nonzero v, the scalar set {a: ||av-w||<r} is an interval of length at most 2r/||v||.
